title: Falcon Heavy Test Flight
summary: SpaceX's livestream of the Falcon Heavy test flight, including the launch, side booster landings and Tesla Roadster payload. It was the first launch of the most powerful operational rocket at the time.
why: HN commenters cite it as a landmark launch broadcast, and also dissect details like the duplicated booster landing feeds.

quote.text: You should watch the launch, its probably one of the most interesting engineering projects of the last few years.
